answer.title: Automated Purchase Order Approval and Creation
answer.trigger: An employee emails a purchase order request with reference details.
steps: Receive the purchase order request email from staff.
AI extracts the item details, reference, and amount, then drafts an approval request.
James reviews and routes the approval request to Sarah.
Sarah reviews the approval decision and grants final sign-off.
James creates the purchase order in the accounts system.
answer.ai_help: Extracting the item details, reference, and amount from incoming emails to draft approval requests.
answer.human_approval: Sarah must approve the purchase order before it is created in the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes could lead to unauthorized purchases being processed and paid for by the business.
